integrity: All statements have a self-contained proof and a separately executable finite-field checker; computational cases illustrate but do not replace universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact periodic-point formula applies only to the unit-torus family with gcd(r,N)=1 and r congruent to 1 modulo q^n-1; no classification of all sparse permutations or independent audit. Generic cyclotomic algorithms are prior art; implicit coverage is a residual originality risk.
title: Exact periodic-point counts for higher unit-torus permutation lifts
